sourceBinding.branch: refs/heads/distro/collabora/co-26.04-mobile (branch tip on both Gerrit and the mirror, verified by ls-remote 2026-10-26)
sourceBinding.monorepoNote: At this revision the former Collabora Office core (LibreOffice fork) is in-tree under engine/ of the online monorepo; there is no separate core repository or core submodule. Upstream text: android/README.md at the revision — 'All the source code now lives in a single Gerrit monorepo; the former Collabora Office core is the engine/ subdirectory of the online repo'.
sourceBinding.buildIdMechanism: The shipped assets/program/versionrc buildid is written by android/lib/build.gradle createRCfiles from coVersionHash = @COOLWSD_VERSION_HASH@ = configure's 'git log -1 --format=%h --abbrev=10' of the producer's checkout. The packaged buildid is therefore the first 10 hex characters of the pinned revision SHA, produced by the documented build itself.
sourceBinding.bindingLimit: Self-stamped build identifier from the producer build procedure; not a third-party attestation and not a reproducible-build proof. The official F-Droid index metadata carries srcname=null (no publisher source name offered in the repo index).
sourceBinding.immutableTagStatus: No Git tag points at this revision for 26.04.4.2-mobile (latest mobile tag on the mirror is 26.04.3-mobile). The release branch tip + version stamps (26.04.4.2 in online configure.ac AC_INIT coolwsd and engine configure.ac AC_INIT 'Collabora Office', plus --with-android-package-versioncode scheme yielding code 937) are the maintained identification chain.
sourceBinding.tagStatus: No Git tag for 26.04.4.2-mobile; the 40-character revision is the identification pin.
